column3: BSB adds “own” twice and ends with “this is the Word of life,” where the Greek has “concerning the Word of life.”
“And this is the life that was revealed” recasts “and the life was revealed”; BSB adds “it” twice.
BSB follows the critical text with “we” and “our joy”; the Textus Receptus has “we write to you” and “your joy.”
BSB follows the critical text with “the blood of Jesus His Son” (no “Christ”).
“Make Him out to be a liar” renders “make Him a liar.”
